input.quote: Each General Manager shall have the authority to make and convey decisions on behalf of each Party and to be the liaison with the other Party for all production and Content matters.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ or engage", "induce", "personnel" and a full read of the operative sections (including sec-5.4, where the General Manager/liaison appointments put named individuals in contact, and the confidentiality, exclusivity and general provisions) show no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant anywhere in the Agreement. The Company is therefore under no restriction on soliciting or hiring HDI personnel, which matches the preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"). The only restrictive covenants present are the Section 6 exclusivity provisions, which concern competing web projects rather than personnel and are addressed under the exclusivity rule. No redline needed.
